scope: Verify responsive position.zIndex through mobile Inspector edit, Canvas, Save/reload, Publish, desktop preservation, reset to inherited value, Undo/Redo, draft Save and separate Publish.
mobile_lifecycle: Mobile z-index 7 reaches Canvas but remains absent from the public snapshot until Publish.
Draft Save and Editor reload preserve the mobile Page Model value.
Explicit Publish updates the public mobile computed CSS while desktop remains independent.
Reset removes only responsive.mobile.zIndex and restores desktop inheritance.
Undo/Redo restore the mobile override and inherited state.
Draft reset Save keeps the published mobile value live; separate Publish applies inherited mobile CSS.
limitations: One responsive property path is covered; this does not certify all Inspector properties or all 79 element types.
Physical-device acceptance remains unverified; 77.44.7.A remains OPEN / NOT CERTIFIED.
